# SYS004: sys-entity-without-code

> Generated: do not edit this page. Regenerate with `cargo dev gen rules`.

| version | 1 |
| since | 2.0.0 |

A binding clause matches no code.

Fires per owns, shape or evidence clause (and once per flow whose ends are both empty) when the clause's selector matches no unit and hides none. Suppressed when the selector's path matches no file (MDL005 says so). Unresolved when only May rows or hidden placeholders are found.

## Examples

### SYS004 sys-entity-without-code / An owns clause matching no unit fires #1 (line 6) (fire)

```text
grimble = "2";
module m;
node a : trusted { owns "src/**"; owns "src/gone.rs::x"; }
node d : trusted { owns "design/**"; }
=== src/gone.rs
pub fn y() {}
```

### SYS004 sys-entity-without-code / A flow with both ends empty fires #2 (line 17) (fire)

```text
grimble = "2";
module m;
node a : trusted { owns "a/**"; }
node b : trusted { owns "b/**"; }
node d : trusted { owns "design/**"; }
flow bare : a -> b {}
=== a/lib.rs
pub fn send() {}
=== b/lib.rs
pub fn recv() {}
```

### SYS004 sys-entity-without-code / Clauses that match code are clean #3 (line 32) (clean)

```text
grimble = "2";
module m;
node a : trusted { owns "src/**"; owns "src/gone.rs::y"; }
node d : trusted { owns "design/**"; }
=== src/gone.rs
```
